name: unwordy
description: Personal and team writing profiles for coding agents. Preserve facts and repository conventions in commits, PRs, reviews, QA reports and design handoffs; local checks flag filler.

interface.longDescription: Writing guidance and local checks for software development teams. Draft Git commit messages, pull request descriptions, code reviews, QA reports and design handoffs. Personal and team profiles keep role and tone independent while preserving supplied facts, test evidence and required repository templates. The full plugin includes a Python checker and optional host hooks; live Codex and Cursor hook enforcement remains unconfirmed.
capabilities: Refine QA reports and design handoffs
defaultPrompt: Write a PR description in our team’s voice, keeping risk and test evidence
Rewrite this bug report without losing reproduction details
